info.name: Veritas InfoScale REST Alerts Service Groups API
info.description:
REST API for managing InfoScale clusters, storage resources, service groups, and high availability configurations. Provides operations for cluster monitoring, storage volume management, service group administration, fencing configuration, and disaster recovery operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: Veritas Support
 Email: support@veritas.com
